fullPassage: My business partner Charles and I embraced the servant leader's way of doing things. In other words, nothing was beneath us. We led by example and did the work. When any new salesman came into the store, he would look around, notice Charles polishing some corner of the floor and me covered in flour, and assume the decision-maker was not present. He'd then hand off whatever he was selling to me and say, "Can you give this to the owner?" Now, if Charles and I had remained in the bakery for too long, we wouldn't have been able to grow and scale, so I'm not saying you should be sweeping the floors forever. It's more about modeling what's important. If cleanliness and details are important, be sure you aren't above doing the work and pitching in. Come into your workspace and ask how you can help. If it's clear your team is in the weeds, jump in without asking.

✅ ③ modeling: 본보기를 보이다, 영영풀이 일치
❌ ① pitching in: 함께 참여하다, 다른 의미
❌ ② sweeping: 쓸다, 다른 의미
❌ ④ polishing: 닦다, 다른 의미
det.tip: model: to demonstrate behavior — 리더가 직접 행동으로 보여줌

questions.passage: My business partner Charles and I embraced the servant leader's way of doing things. In other words, nothing was beneath us. We led by example and did the work. When any new salesman came into the store, he would look around, notice Charles polishing some corner of the floor and me covered in flour, and assume the decision-maker was not present. He'd then hand off whatever he was selling to me and say, "Can you give this to the owner?" Now, if Charles and I had remained in the bakery for too long, we wouldn't have been able to grow and scale, so I'm not saying you should be sweeping the floors forever. It's more about modeling what's important. If cleanliness and details are important, be sure you aren't above doing the work and pitching in. Come into your workspace and ask how you can help. If it's clear your team is in the weeds, jump in without asking.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 해당하는 영어 표현을 고르시오.

"솔선수범하다"

det.korean: 솔선수범하다 = lead by example(모범을 보이며 이끌다).
det.analysis:
✅ ① lead by example: 모범을 보이며 이끌다, 솔선수범
❌ ② hand off: 넘겨주다, 다른 의미
❌ ③ jump in: 뛰어들다, 다른 의미
❌ ④ grow and scale: 성장하고 규모를 키우다, 다른 의미
det.tip: lead by example = 솔선수범하다 — 직접 모범을 보이며 이끄는 리더십

questions.stem: 글에서 scale이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성장(grow)하고 규모를 키울(scale) 수 없었을 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 사업 규모를 확대하다: 문맥상 grow와 병렬, 사업 확장 의미
❌ ① 저울로 재다: scale의 명사/동사 의미, 부적절
❌ ② 비늘 벗기다: scale의 다른 의미, 부적절
❌ ④ 오르다: scale a wall의 의미, 부적절
det.tip: scale: ① 저울 ② 규모 ③ 비늘 ④ 오르다 — 여기서는 사업 규모를 키우다(scale up)

questions.stem: 다음 중 단어의 형태 변환이 올바르게 짝지어진 것은?

det.korean: clean(깨끗한, 형용사) → cleanliness(청결, 명사): 올바른 어형 변환.
det.analysis:
✅ ② clean → cleanliness: 형용사 → 명사, 올바른 변환
❌ ① embracement는 형용사가 아닌 명사형
❌ ③ decidion → decision이 올바름
❌ ④ presently는 동사가 아닌 부사
det.tip: clean(형용사) → cleanliness(명사) / decide → decision / present → presently(부사)
